text:
mike_support: Heads-up — Acme reported a 400 on POST /v1/rerank. They say candidates are being sent as empty strings and top_k as a string. Pasting the payload + service response they got below.

mike_support: ```json
{
  "queries": [{"id": "q1", "text": "Which product should I recommend?"}],
  "candidates": ["", "", ""],
  "top_k": "2"
}
```

mike_support: Response: ```json
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid candidates: expected array of objects with 'id' and 'text'",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "candidates",
    "request_id": "req_acme_7b9f"
  }
}
```

devin_engineer: Can you paste the raw body exactly as received (no pretty print) and confirm whether this hit hosted or Dedicated? Also need the request_id from logs — I see one in the error (req_acme_7b9f) but want the full header trace.

mike_support: Raw body from customer (copied): ```json
{"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"Which product should I recommend?"}],"candidates":["","",""],"top_k":"2"}
```

mike_support: This hit our hosted API (us-west). Error request_id matches logs: req_acme_7b9f.

devin_engineer: OK that matches schema validation. The rerank schema requires candidates to be objects: [{"id":"...","text":"..."}, ...]. Empty strings will throw. Also top_k should be an integer, not a string — our validator rejects non-number here.

devin_engineer: Quick repro curl (will return 400):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"Which product?"}],"candidates":["",""],"top_k":"2"}'
```

mike_support: Customer says their JS client constructs candidates from a free-form list and sometimes ends up with blanks when a DB field is null. They sent screenshots of the client code. They are on sdk-js 2.3.1.

devin_engineer: sdk-js 2.3.1 had a serialization quirk where empty strings from some ORMs weren't filtered and number fields could be stringified in a couple of call paths. We should ask the customer to either: 1) filter out falsy/empty candidate entries and coerce top_k to a number, or 2) upgrade to sdk-js 2.4.0 which includes the fix. I'll also add a server-side guard to return a clearer error and a short doc snippet.

maria_engineer: I'll create a tiny validation middleware in the API gateway that rejects candidates that are not objects or that have empty text. Will add a unit test for arrays with empty-string items and for top_k as strings. Planning canary deploy to staging first.

ci-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary/validation-middleware -> staging at 2024-09-12T14:00:00Z (pipeline #4621).

maria_engineer: After canary I'll open a PSR to add a helpful error message: "candidates must be array of {id,text}; remove empty entries or send id/text pairs" and include an SDK snippet to sanitize input.

devin_engineer: Short-term workaround for support to pass to customer: filter out empty strings before sending, and convert top_k to a number (e.g., Number(top_k) in JS). Example: 
```js
const payload = { queries, candidates: candidates.filter(c => c && typeof c === 'object' && c.text), top_k: Number(top_k) };
```

mike_support: Thanks — I'll send that guidance and recommend upgrading to sdk-js 2.4.0. Marking as support-escalated -> engineering. Will follow up if they still see 400s after the changes. :thumbsup:
